The Kija Method · Brand Signal Test

Six questions.
One honest score.

The short version. No email, no gate, no follow-up unless you ask for one. It scores four things: whether your position is clear, whether your identity is a system, whether your digital presence does any work, and whether anything happens automatically after a lead arrives.

02

Why this is free

Because it is the demonstration. Creative Strategy is the hardest capability to prove on a services page, so we gave the diagnosis away instead of describing our ability to produce one.

What you get

A real diagnosis

A score, a pillar breakdown and the three weakest areas named specifically — not a lead magnet with your name pasted in.

What we get

A better first call

When you do book, we already know where the problem is. The call starts at the useful part instead of the introductions.

What happens next

Nothing you did not ask for

No countdown timer, no daily sequence, no sales call you did not book. One email, and you can leave the list from it.

03

Rather just
talk it through?

The test is useful, but it is not a conversation. If you already know roughly what is wrong, skip it.
